beats.say: After you deposit, the platform shows you a nice chart and a growing balance.
On a fake platform these numbers are just text on a screen, with no money behind them.

body.text: To withdraw, first pay 15% income tax: 1,870 AZN

beats.say: When you try to withdraw, they ask for tax, a fee or insurance. That is the final stage of the scam.

body.text: To withdraw, first pay 15% income tax: 1,870 AZN

beats.say: If a withdrawal needs a payment first, stop and do not send a single manat more.

scenes.prompt: Find the signs of fraud on this dashboard.

body.text: To withdraw, first pay 15% income tax: 1,870 AZN
Offer ends in 2 hours. Contact your manager in the messenger.

spots.label: Miracle growth
spots.explain: Quadrupling in a few months almost never happens in a real market. Anyone can type a number on a screen.

spots.label: Guaranteed returns
spots.explain: Investment returns cannot be guaranteed. The word itself is a warning.

spots.label: Pay to withdraw
spots.explain: A real platform does not ask you to send new money to release yours. Pay it and another excuse will follow.

spots.label: Fake licence
spots.explain: Such a body may not even exist, and a foreign licence gives no right here anyway. Look at the Central Bank's list.

spots.label: Rushing you
spots.explain: The deadline is there so you have no time to think or ask anyone.

scenes.title: Withdrawing the money
scenes.intro: Your balance on the platform has grown and you want to withdraw. Decide at each step.

steps.label: Your balance: 12,480 AZN. Upgrade to VIP
steps.say: The balance has grown. Now try to withdraw.

actions.label: Withdraw
actions.feedback: Trying to withdraw does no harm. See what they ask for on the next screen.

actions.label: Add 500 AZN, go VIP
actions.feedback: The balance on screen is not real, and new money will be lost too. Stop.

body.text: A 15% income tax is required to withdraw: 1,870 AZN.
If the tax is not paid, funds will be frozen in 48 hours.

steps.say: They want a tax before the withdrawal.

actions.label: Pay the tax
actions.feedback: After the tax they will ask for insurance, then a commission. The balance will never come out.

actions.label: Cancel
actions.feedback: Right. Being asked to pay to withdraw shows the platform is fake.

steps.label: We recover lost investments in 30 days
steps.say: A few days later this ad appears.

actions.label: Apply
actions.feedback: A promise to recover money can be a second trap. See what they ask for next.

actions.label: Close the tab
actions.feedback: Right. A service that promises to get your money back is often a second scam.

steps.say: To get money back, they want a payment up front too.

actions.label: Pay 300 AZN and start
actions.feedback: This is the second scam, sometimes run by the same gang. Block the card and tell the police.

actions.label: Close the tab
actions.feedback: Good call. To trace the money, go to your bank and the police, and that costs nothing.

body.text: Report bakutrade-pro.example.net as a fraudulent site?

steps.say: The browser offers to report the site.

actions.label: Report
actions.feedback: Great, reporting helps block the site for others. Contact the police on 102 as well.

actions.label: Later
actions.feedback: Not reporting lets the scammers find new victims. Take a minute and report it.

nodes.text: Look, I put in 400 manat and today it is 1,200. Join us.
nodes.speaker: Gunay, your colleague (group "Smart Investors")
nodes.spoken: Look, I put in 400 manat and today it is 1,200. <breath> Join us.

choices.label: Let's check the licence in the Central Bank's list first
choices.feedback: Right. Even a friend's tip does not make a platform legal.

choices.label: If Gunay is earning, I am in
choices.feedback: The profit on Gunay's screen may be fake too. Scammers pull people in through people they know.

nodes.text: Forget the list, we have a foreign licence. Only 3 places left!
nodes.speaker: Group admin
nodes.spoken: Forget the list, <breath> we have a foreign licence. Only 3 places left!

choices.label: A foreign licence gives no right here, I am out
choices.feedback: Right. The Central Bank has warned that a foreign licence gives no right to operate here.

choices.label: Join fast before the places run out
choices.feedback: Limited places are there to rush you. Pressure like this is itself a sign of fraud.

nodes.text: What about my 400 manat? I want to withdraw, and they say I must pay a tax.
nodes.speaker: Gunay
nodes.spoken: What about my 400 manat? I want to withdraw, <short pause> and they say I must pay a tax.

choices.label: Pay nothing, call your bank, report it on 102
choices.feedback: Great. Reporting in time stops the loss and protects others.

choices.label: Pay the tax, then the money will come
choices.feedback: After the tax there will be a new excuse. The loss will only grow.

choices.label: Ask in the group, the admins will help
choices.feedback: The admins are the scammers themselves. They will only ask for another payment.

points: Profit on a screen is not money: if withdrawing needs a payment, stop.
A service promising to recover your money is a second scam.
Check the licence and report fraud to the police on 102.
